chunks: Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man who performs salat (prayer) while wearing a burṭulah, so he said: “It does not harm him.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْبُرْطُلَةُ: a burṭulah, a type of head covering or cap
key_terms.لَا يَضُرُّهُ: it does not harm him; it poses no problem for the prayer
key_terms.يُونُسُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ: Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, the narrator who asked the Imam

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while wearing a burṭulah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) attire. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that praying while wearing a burṭulah does not invalidate or negatively affect the prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.817 - Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about a man praying while wearing a burṭulah (a type of hat or head covering).
The Imam said: "It does not harm him (there is no issue)."
